items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: This incorrect-authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application.
